content:
Developers can now submit apps for iOS 27 and other new Apple operating systems, which will officially launch next Monday. Here are the details of the update.

Developers can now submit apps built for iOS 27.

Apple confirmed yesterday at its "Surf and Shine" event that iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27 will officially debut next Monday (September 14).

Apple announced today that developers can now download the Xcode 27 Release Candidate and submit apps and games using the latest SDK for review.

Apple also reminded developers that macOS 27 will only support software built for Apple silicon:

In addition, Apple reminded developers to answer the new age rating questionnaire, as the questions apply to features such as Screen Time. Apple also encouraged developers to prepare new title designs and search result assets for their App Store product pages, and provided updated design guidelines and templates to help them create product pages, screenshots, app previews, and in-app events.

Finally, Apple reiterated that "starting April 2027, apps and games uploaded to App Store Connect must meet the following minimum requirements":

  • iOS and iPadOS apps must be built with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 SDK or later
  • tvOS apps must be built with tvOS 27 SDK or later
  • visionOS apps must be built with visionOS 27 SDK or later
  • watchOS apps must be built with watchOS 27 SDK or later
